For survival prediction tasks, H-Optimus-0 [ 67 ] is the best performing model, but it is noteworthy that all models perform close to the chance level (C-Index of 50) for this task. Table 3 shows results for resource efficient models. Atlas 2-B and Atlas 2-S are distilled from Atlas 2 and are 24 and 91 times smaller in parameter size and 3.4 and 9 times more resource efficient for a standard-size image inference. The results show that Atlas 2-B and Atlas 2-S are the best performing models in 22/27 and 25/27 tasks and at least second best in 27/27 and 26/27 respectively in their respective compute category. Despite being more resource efficient, Atlas 2-B performs similar to or on par with larger models Atlas [ 2 ] , and UNI2-H [ 13 ] and outperforms the larger models H-Optimus-0 [ 67 ] , Midnight-12k [ 39 ] , and Virchow2 [ 82 ] . Atlas 2-S achieves similar performance as H-Optimus-0 [ 67 ] , Midnight-12k [ 39 ] , and Virchow2 [ 82 ] despite being 4.3-7.4 times more resource efficient for a standard-size image inference. The models also show significantly better robustness with an improvement of 29.3 p.p. and 24.7 p.p. compared to the second best model, respectively.
